en.p: For a polynomial function $f(x)$, the function $g(x)$ is defined as follows.
For the function $h(x)=\displaystyle\lim_{t\to 0+}g(x+t)\times\lim_{t\to 2+}g(x+t)$, which of the statements in <Statements> are correct? [4 points]

box: b. The function $h(x)$ is continuous on the set of all real numbers.
c. If the function $g(x)$ is decreasing on the closed interval $[-1,\,1]$ and $g(-1)=-2$, then the function $h(x)$ has a minimum value on the set of all real numbers.
